utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: Today we fly the prototype with the 1103s, 15000KV, and the Gemfan 2020 four-blades.

utterances.speaker: Lea
utterances.text: It hovers cleanly, and the Matrix AIO stays cool.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: The Gemfan 2020s fit the 1103s well. We will use them again.
